package.scope: Single active motherboard engineering candidate. No offered production package has been qualified; screen size, licence or optional AI cannot remove fitted motor/I/O requirements. Each eventual offered package needs its own acceptance record.
package.configuration: Source26/ROOT104/CAD30 baseline with all twelve motor interfaces, four base ABZ, 24 general DI and 16 smart DO plus required interfaces. Source27 is staged. Exact qualified compute/ESP/storage/display/harness/enclosure SKUs and software revisions are not frozen.

note: All gates remain incomplete. Historical or bounded source/host/RTL evidence is not a complete product acceptance. Empty evidence lists intentionally contain no invented passes.

gates.requirement: All twelve complete motor interfaces fitted on one motherboard, at least eight usable motors, individual enable and alarm on every channel
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Source26 represents all twelve STEP/DIR, enable and alarm interfaces; 3,508 required board joins remain in the last verified ROOT104 baseline. Complete CNC3/RTL/HAL and vendor/physical qualification remain unfinished. Historical runtime is six/two.

gates.requirement: 24 general DI and 16 smart general DO remain available with all twelve motor interfaces
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Source26 represents 24 general DI and 16 smart DO with acquisition/control circuitry. Full routing, actual concurrent I/O runtime and electrical/thermal qualification remain unfinished.

gates.requirement: Serially communicated local I/O/real accessories validate versioned board/region or actual-module identity, sequence/freshness and CRC before outputs change
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Marker bits/readback alone are insufficient.

gates.requirement: Independent fault-to-inhibit bound no greater than 20 ms for declared covered faults
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open for current dual TPS3851 candidate integrated in MC r0.4. Historical TPS3431 screened approximately 64–72 ms and failed. Current [numerical review](../reports/next-implementation-20260930/WATCHDOG_NUMERICAL_REVIEW.md) retains conditional leakage/setup assumptions, open guaranteed SET1 timing and unqualified full-path/self-test bounds; no physical 20 ms acceptance is established. A clocked FPGA timer alone does not cover clock stall.

gates.requirement: Reliable full exchange at 1 kHz, completion target 700 microseconds under defined worst-case load
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Mock SPI and simulation wire arithmetic do not qualify a physical cycle.

gates.requirement: 72-hour combined-load run plus fault injection with all twelve motors and any offered encoder/process expansion operating together
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. No such physical trial.

gates.requirement: Power/protection works at the declared voltage/load/environment limits across all populations
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Historical expanded central-power arithmetic exceeded its 6 A budget in required cases. The historical reset physical-pin defect was repaired and propagated; MC r0.4 has local rail generation/window supervision with native ERC zero. Complete product loads, protection, PDN/routing, sequencing/partial-power, transient/thermal and physical tests remain unqualified.

gates.requirement: Every displayed measurement has validity and age; stale/disconnected never appears as plausible zero
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Source26 represents output current/fault acquisition paths. Complete routing, calibration, actual firmware/transport and deployed validity/age UI remain unqualified.

gates.requirement: Hardware-backed output/supply/module/temperature diagnostics and power-loss-tolerant local fault history
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. IC or GPIO reservations are not complete diagnostics.

gates.requirement: Eight of ten first-time users reach a verified low-speed jog within 15 minutes on the reference machine
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Older app-interaction timing exercises are separate metrics.

gates.requirement: Replace approved purchased compute/ESP/settings modules with power off; separately exchange a motherboard through retained terminal/harness groups without conductor retermination, ordinary customer soldering/programming or lost configuration
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Historical file-only virtual-card replacement evidence does not qualify current module or whole-board service.

gates.requirement: Machine configuration survives interrupted writes and compatible compute/module replacement
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Host file/journal models do not qualify physical storage.

gates.requirement: No automatic motion resume after a fault, power loss or service replacement
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Partly demonstrated in six/two simulation; expanded physical product open.

gates.requirement: One service contract for UI, CLI and assistants; discover, validate, preview/diff, reversible configuration within real limits
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Partial disconnected profiles plus separate bounded runtime XYZ service. Production unification open.

gates.requirement: Preserve the intended Octopus/MR-1 experience and provide CAD/model and no-CAD setup routes
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Scene metadata validation is not the requested renderer or CAD workflow.

gates.requirement: Qualify every offered screen/host package independently of I/O tier
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open for all screen classes. Connector shape is not compute compatibility.

gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.

gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.

gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.

gates.requirement: Plasma upgrades retain unaffected setup and support the first divided-voltage module with two qualified source/harness profiles
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.

gates.requirement: PCBWay turnkey and complete product economics are reviewable before ordering
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. The last verified Source26/ROOT104 baseline has 1,101 incomplete multi-pad nets and 3,508 required joins. [Current partial BOM](../reports/motherboard-cost-20260930/source-r26-2688-complete-cost-v11/README.md) leaves 185 MPNs/720 purchased pieces unpriced; complete assembly/module/screen cost and manufacturer quotes remain missing. No Gerber/drill/final assembly release or manufacturing-ready claim.

gates.requirement: Twelve simultaneous STEP/DIR channels at up to 2 MHz/channel with individually enforced STEP-high/low, DIR-setup/hold, polarity and maximum-rate profiles; atomic twelve-channel updates in a deterministic 1 kHz LinuxCNC servo cycle
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. New isolated twelve-generator HDL sweep passes 144 cases and exact DDS boundary checks; experimental 12/12 ticks has effectively no margin at 2 MHz. Complete twelve-channel CNC3 endpoint, dynamic timing profiles, actual driver/cable timing, target load and hardware qualification remain unfinished. Historical six-channel 195,312.5 pulses/s runtime limit is unchanged.

gates.requirement: Four base ABZ encoder paths plus qualified expansion toward twelve ABZ channels, simultaneously with all twelve motor interfaces and preserved I/O/process functions
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open expansion target. Four base receiving paths are represented in current source; source representation is distinct from four- or twelve-encoder runtime and physical qualification. No custom motor daughterboard is introduced.

gates.requirement: Pre-fabrication performance limits and one-command virtual bench, with simulated/design/datasheet/physical evidence kept separate
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Partial actual component evidence:144 steady twelve-generator cases plus dynamic/reversal and four-encoder sweeps pass; CNC3 structural SPI/codec/family mapping and selected passive/buffer SPICE pass. Stateful CNC3/HAL,complete analog chain,full-load machine,vendor fit and physical qualification remain unfinished.

gates.requirement: AI acts as a grounded CNC setup specialist, produces a validated supported setup efficiently and protects the roughly US$15 API allowance
gates.scope: Not accepted for this engineering package.
gates.reason: Open. Controller has simulated profiles and bounded separate runtime services; no integrated setup expert, customer frontend, approved physical profile catalog or cost enforcement. External candidate keyword assistant fails negation/intent tests and is not adopted.
